title: Universe inside a black hole (torsion)
example_questions: What if our universe is inside a black hole?
What happens to matter inside a black hole?
summary: In Einstein-Cartan gravity, spacetime torsion created by the spin of matter becomes repulsive at extreme densities. Matter falling into a black hole would bounce instead of forming a singularity, creating a new expanding universe on the other side. Our own Big Bang could have been such a bounce inside a black hole in a parent universe.
support_note: Pursued by a small number of researchers; not tested observationally.
what_happens: Matter collapses inside a black hole
Torsion halts the collapse and causes a bounce
A new universe expands on the far side of the horizon
objections: Einstein-Cartan effects are negligible except at extreme density, so hard to test

sources.title: Cosmology with torsion: An alternative to cosmic inflation
